props.title: Denver corporate holiday parties, November and December.
props.lede: The remarks end, the bandleader counts in the first song, and the people who said they’d leave after dinner are still on the floor when the lights come up. props.title: Three common configurations of a holiday party.
props.lede: Most corporate holiday parties land on one of these three. Any of them can be paired: a duo through drinks and dinner with the DJ carrying the back half is one contract for the whole night.

picks.why: The dance floor booking. Book this when the party is the point.
Drinks and dinner covered without anybody raising their voice over it. The safest booking on the page for a night that has speeches in it.
The whole night on one line, at the smallest number on this page. The format most corporate parties actually book.

props.html: Every act is on the roster page. Live band karaoke is its own act this season, the band that plays the 80s and 90s hits and hands the mic to anyone who wants a song, and for the dinner half of a December party the Christmas jazz trio plays the season’s songs. A pianist plays the office party that stays a dinner all evening.

props.title: Three things to know about a December party.

props.html: There are speeches, and they’re the point. Somebody thanks the team, somebody announces the number, somebody hands out an award. The speaker gets an announcement microphone at every size, and the music stops while they’re still steps from it.

Half the crowd wants to talk and the other half is waiting to dance. That’s what the duo-plus-DJ pairing is for: standards under the conversation through dinner, then the DJ turns the same sound system to the dance floor, and both halves get their night.
The venue is usually a restaurant or a hotel ballroom, built for dinners more than bands, and we settle setup, power and the volume limit with it before the day.
Run of show and booking details are on the planners pages. A holiday party at a house, on the same December calendar, is on the holiday party at home page.

props.title: Denver’s December venues.
props.lede: A Denver company party in December usually means a downtown hotel, and every company that waits until November is asking those calendars for the same two or three Saturdays, which is why the season is decided months before it starts.

props.html: The Denver page carries the downtown season in detail, and sixteen of the venues this market books are covered one by one in the Denver venue guide. Colorado Springs, an hour south, runs a calendar of its own, and a Springs date carries a Front Range travel line. Both sit under the corporate page, what the Colorado market charges for a December band is in the cost guide, and when December’s evening is a dinner more than a party, client dinners has a page of its own.

items.q: Which dates does the Denver holiday season cover?
items.a: 21 party dates across November and December 2026, 10 of them in December, covering Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays plus New Year's Eve. The peak December dates are marked, because this market prices a holiday weekend above a standard date. Tell us the date and the venue and we'll check the booking calendar.

items.q: When do companies book holiday party entertainment?
items.a: August through October is when the season is decided for November and December dates, and New Year's Eve books first of all. Booking early is how you get the date you want; it doesn't change the price.

Through dinner, quiet enough that a table of colleagues talks across it; for the remarks, silent; once the program ends, as loud as a dance floor and the venue allow. Give us the venue's sound limit when we sign and the night is built under it.

items.q: What does the venue need to provide?
items.a: Hotel function space comes with a dock time, an elevator window and an hour when the space becomes yours. Setup runs 45 to 90 minutes depending on the size of the act and needs one or two dedicated 20-amp circuits, and we coordinate it with the banquet staff before the day.

items.q: Can our procurement process clear a booking in time?
items.a: Yes, if it starts early. We can be set up as a vendor and quote against a purchase order, and the certificate of insurance, the W-9 and one itemized invoice come with the contract. Vendor onboarding is usually the slowest step of a corporate booking, so start it when you shortlist.

props.title: The January holiday party.
props.lede: A growing share of Denver companies hold the party in January, and the venues have followed: several now write their holiday packages to run into the third week of January and past it. In January, the party has the calendar to itself.

props.html: Everything on this page works in January without a change of repertoire, because standards, covers and a dance set were never seasonal. A few things work even better in January, when the crowd isn’t spread across a season of invitations: the live band karaoke night, the yacht rock band, and the set piece from Dirty Flamenco.

The mountain version is the same evening with snow outside it. A January date at a Vail or Breckenridge venue is an après-ski party by default, and the retreats page carries the travel and lodging lines that go with it.
Ideas built for that month, themes included, are in January office party ideas.
